members.name: errorMessage
members.doc: Shown once for the whole group, only while the group is invalid, through the invalid prop or failed native, custom, or server validation. It replaces the built-in message and never makes the group invalid by itself.

members.name: options
members.doc: The radios the group builds, one per option. A non-empty options cannot be combined with children: passing both throws a TypeError.

members.name: children
members.doc: RadioField radios, when the group does not build them from options. They cannot be combined with a non-empty options.

members.name: value
members.doc: The value of the selected radio, when the caller controls it.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: The value of the radio that starts selected, when the group controls itself.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Called with the value of the radio each time one is selected. A disabled or read-only group does not call it.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the group and every radio in it.

members.name: readOnly
members.doc: Makes the group read-only: its radios stay visible and focusable but cannot be changed.

members.name: required
members.doc: Marks the group required, so a form with native validation does not submit while no radio is selected.

members.name: invalid
members.doc: Marks the group invalid and shows its error message. Left false, validation decides, so failed native, custom, or server validation can still make the group invalid.

members.name: orientation
members.doc: Whether the radios stack in a column or sit in a row.

members.name: size
members.doc: The control size. The radios take it from the group.

members.name: name
members.doc: The form field name. A named group submits the selected value under it.
